## Description
A real scheduled **main** Full Regression executed the complete canonical Playwright suite at exact SHA `493b877de1ae746eb6b549a1d2edceb4d0e398cc`, but independent per-ID verification correctly rejected **two flaky terminal cases**. This is not an all-Pass run. Keep the two observed failure mechanisms separate during diagnosis; do not assume a common runtime cause.

## Reproduction
- [Run #45073609641](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/45073609641), attempt 1, main, pinned SHA `493b877de1ae746eb6b549a1d2edceb4d0e398cc`, 2026-11-22 21:47–22:02 UTC.
- Job [`full` #137365967833](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/45073609641/job/137365967833): step 14 `Run full canonical Playwright suite at pinned SHA` **Success**; step 15 `Verify complete per-ID assertions` **Failure**, assertion `full Playwright report is not an all-Pass run` (`e2e/runner/e2e-full-per-id-receipt.mjs:34`).
- [Original artifact #14774248256](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/45073609641/artifacts/14774248256), digest `sha256:624eed9c87e9a146eb7716342d684164db367d9487d399c6461c9df276f527ac`. Downloaded original ZIP via GitHub connector and inspected `_temp/full-regression-playwright.json` and failure candidate. Playwright stats: `expected=525`, `unexpected=0`, `skipped=0`, **`flaky=2`**; `observed_tests=527` includes retries, not 527 independently passing tests.
- Flaky A: `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts`, **a writer overflow replaces the renderer and resumes output (#2196)**. First attempt failed after 67.2 s: locator `[data-terminal-notices~="history-degraded"]` expected count 1, received 0, polling timeout 6000 ms; retry passed in 7.4 s.
- Flaky B: `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-io.spec.ts`, **Web: a relative reference from the filesystem root never falls back into the source root**. First attempt failed after 30.7 s: expected `true`, received `false`, with `Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded`; retry passed in 11.6 s.

## Impact
Canonical Playwright Gate reported Success but strict independent Full per-ID attestation correctly failed closed. The first failures are browser terminal state/timeout assertions, **not evidenced cache, runner startup, artifact upload, or authorization errors**. Root causes remain unverified; successful retries must not be interpreted as Pass. This blocks a credible main Full Pass for this SHA.

## Location
- `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts` (Flaky A: writer overflow / history-degraded notice)
- `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-io.spec.ts` (Flaky B: root-CWD relative reference navigation)
- `e2e/runner/e2e-full-per-id-receipt.mjs` (verifier that correctly rejected the run at line 34)

## Investigation Status
Root causes remain unverified. The two flaky cases have distinct failure signatures and must be diagnosed independently:
- Flaky A: locator polling timeout on `[data-terminal-notices~="history-degraded"]` — could be a real transient terminal state where the notice is not emitted within the 6000 ms window, or a test synchronization defect where the assertion races against renderer recovery.
- Flaky B: 30-second test timeout on a root-CWD relative reference navigation — could be a real path-resolution regression or a wait on stale UI/async state during navigation.

Prior closed issues (#2196, #3414, #3273, #3200) addressed different persistent defects; this run observes flaky/timeout behavior, not proof those original bugs returned.

## Fix Direction
1. Inspect original trace/video and first-attempt errors for both cases; compare first failure vs retry and source-aligned test helpers; check whether `history-degraded` notice is intentionally transient and whether the root-CWD navigation waits on stale UI/async state.
2. Distinguish a real terminal recovery/path correctness regression from a test synchronization defect using deterministic negative/positive fixtures. Fix the owning producer/test helper, not the Full verifier.
3. Keep the two repair tracks independent if evidence reveals unrelated causes; split into focused implementation Issues only when concrete causes are established. No blind retries, blanket timeouts, weakened assertions, skipped cases, or baseline refresh.

## Existing ownership / non-duplication
- #2196 (closed) fixed a persistent overflow renderer-repair defect; this run observes a **flaky degraded notice assertion**, not proof that the original persistent freeze returned.
- #3414 (closed) fixed filesystem-root CWD path identity; this run observes a **timeout/flaky navigation test**, not proof that the old path join bug returned.
- #3273 and #3200 (closed) concern other terminal-io synchronization races. Do not reopen/overwrite their accepted historical evidence without verifying the same mechanism.
- #4235 is closed and separately accepted; do not reopen it or conflate its visual baseline failures with this run.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01: Exact first-attempt trace evidence establishes the failure boundary for each of the two cases, with independent reproduction or a deterministic race fixture and an identified owning component/helper.
- [ ] SC-02: Source-aligned tests demonstrate terminal overflow recovery and root-CWD exact-source navigation without transient-state false failures, including negative fixtures; existing safety/path assertions are preserved.
- [ ] SC-03: A subsequent authenticated, exact-SHA main Full run executes `full` and both steps 14/15 succeed, with `unexpected=0`, `skipped=0`, `flaky=0`, and complete per-ID assertions; previous failed run remains failed.

SC scenario mapping: SC-01/02 browser terminal runtime + fixture observations (SCN-02); SC-03 authenticated GitHub Run/Job/Step and artifact evidence (SCN-05). Use existing approved Chromium CI and Full receipt lanes; no new proof method or privileges.

    when: pr

  SC-03:
